template: Test execution data exported by {userName} in format {format}

name: LOG.CORE.AUTH.LOGOUT
purpose: Logs when a user logs out
template: User {userName} (ID: {userId}) logged out

name: LOG.CORE.AUTH.TOKEN_REFRESHED
purpose: Logs when a user token is refreshed
template: Token refreshed for user {userName} (ID: {userId})

name: LOG.CORE.AUTH.PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED
purpose: Logs when a password reset is requested
template: Password reset requested for user {userName} from IP {ipAddress}

name: LOG.CORE.AUTH.PASSWORD_RESET_COMPLETED
purpose: Logs when a password reset is completed
template: Password reset completed for user {userName} (ID: {userId})

name: LOG.CORE.AUTH.USER_PROFILE_VIEWED
purpose: Logs when user profile is viewed
template: User profile viewed by {userName}

name: LOG.CORE.AUTH.SESSION_EXPIRED
purpose: Logs when a user session expires
template: Session expired for user {userName} (ID: {userId})

name: LOG.CORE.AUTH.UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS
purpose: Logs when unauthorized access is attempted
template: Unauthorized access attempted by user {userName} to resource {resource} from IP {ipAddress}
